snippet.title: Poop Killer   The Golden Fart [Official Trailer]
snippet.description:
Jason and Derek are two stoners on a road trip searching for the legendary Holy Weed. But when the Poop Killer returns, they must find the mysterious Golden Fart before it's too late!
